data.page_content:
Perfect Blueberry Scones

Prep time: 15 minutes | Cook time: 18 minutes | Difficulty: Easy

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Add cold butter cubes and use a pastry cutter or your fingers to work the butter into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs with some pea-sized pieces remaining.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir with a fork until just combined. Do not overmix.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat into a 7-inch circle about 1-inch thick.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes, or until golden brown on top and bottom.
  11. Cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.

### Perfect Blueberry Scones
**Prep time:** 15 minutes  
**Cook time:** 18 minutes  
**Difficulty:** Easy  

#### Ingredients
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tablespoon baking powder
- 1/2 teaspoon salt
- 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
- 1 cup fresh blueberries
- 2/3 cup heavy cream
- 1 large egg
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
- Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

#### Instructions
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
3. Add cold butter cubes and use a pastry cutter or your fingers to work the butter into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs with some pea-sized pieces remaining.
4. Gently fold in blueberries.
5. In a separate bowl, whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir with a fork until just combined. Do not overmix.
7. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat into a 7-inch circle about 1-inch thick.
8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
10. Bake for 18-22 minutes, or until golden brown on top and bottom.
11. Cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.

#### Baker's Tips
- Keep all ingredients cold for flaky scones.
- Frozen blueberries can be used instead of fresh; do not thaw before using.

data.page_content:
Blueberry Scones Recipe

Preparation Time: 15 minutes
Cook Time: 20 minutes
Total Time: 35 minutes
Servings: 8 scones

Ingredients:
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tablespoon baking powder
- 1/2 teaspoon salt
- 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
- 1 cup fresh blueberries
- 1 large egg
- 1/2 cup heavy cream, plus extra for brushing
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
- Coarse sugar for sprinkling

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
4. Gently fold in blueberries.
5. In a separate bowl, whisk together egg, heavy cream, and vanilla extract.
6. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
7. Turn dough onto a lightly floured surface and shape into a 7-inch circle.
8. Cut into 8 wedges and transfer to prepared baking sheet.
9. Brush tops with heavy cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
10. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
11. Cool on wire rack for 10 minutes before serving.

Tips:
- Keep butter and cream cold for flaky scones
- Don't overmix the dough
- Fresh or frozen blueberries work well
- Serve with clotted cream or lemon curd

Nutritional Information (per scone):
Calories: 280 | Fat: 14g | Carbs: 34g | Protein: 4g

data.page_content:
Perfect Blueberry Scones

Prep time: 15 minutes | Cook time: 18 minutes | Difficulty: Easy

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Add cold butter cubes and use a pastry cutter or your fingers to work the butter into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs with some pea-sized pieces remaining.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir with a fork until just combined. Do not overmix.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat into a 7-inch circle about 1-inch thick.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes, or until golden brown on top and bottom.
  11. Cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.

**Blueberry Scones Recipe**  
**Preparation Time**: 15 minutes  
**Cook Time**: 20 minutes  
**Total Time**: 35 minutes  
**Servings**: 8 scones  

**Ingredients**:  
- 2 cups all-purpose flour  
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar  
- 1 tablespoon baking powder  
- 1/2 teaspoon salt  
- 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed  
- 1 cup fresh blueberries  
- 1 large egg  
- 1/2 cup heavy cream, plus extra for brushing  
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract  
- Coarse sugar for sprinkling  

**Instructions**:  
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.  
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.  
3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.  
4. Gently fold in blueberries.  
5. In a separate bowl, whisk together egg, heavy cream, and vanilla extract.  
6. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined.  
7. Turn dough onto a lightly floured surface and shape into a 7-inch circle.  
8. Cut into 8 wedges and transfer to prepared baking sheet.  
9. Brush tops with heavy cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar.  
10. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.  
11. Cool on wire rack for 10 minutes before serving.  

**Tips**:  
- Keep butter and cream cold for flaky scones.  
- Don't overmix the dough.  
- Fresh or frozen blueberries work well.  
- Serve with clotted cream or lemon curd.

data.page_title: Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.page_content:
Blueberry Scones Recipe

Preparation Time: 15 minutes
Cook Time: 20 minutes
Total Time: 35 minutes
Servings: 8 scones

Ingredients:
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tablespoon baking powder
- 1/2 teaspoon salt
- 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
- 1 cup fresh blueberries
- 1 large egg
- 1/2 cup heavy cream, plus extra for brushing
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
- Coarse sugar for sprinkling

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
4. Gently fold in blueberries.
5. In a separate bowl, whisk together egg, heavy cream, and vanilla extract.
6. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
7. Turn dough onto a lightly floured surface and shape into a 7-inch circle.
8. Cut into 8 wedges and transfer to prepared baking sheet.
9. Brush tops with heavy cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
10. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
11. Cool on wire rack for 10 minutes before serving.

Tips:
- Keep butter and cream cold for flaky scones
- Don't overmix the dough
- Fresh or frozen blueberries work well
- Serve with clotted cream or lemon curd

Nutritional Information (per scone):
Calories: 280 | Fat: 14g | Carbs: 34g | Protein: 4g

### Perfect Blueberry Scones Recipe
**Prep time:** 15 minutes  
**Cook time:** 18 minutes  
**Difficulty:** Easy  

#### Ingredients
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tablespoon baking powder
- 1/2 teaspoon salt
- 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
- 1 cup fresh blueberries
- 2/3 cup heavy cream
- 1 large egg
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
- Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

#### Instructions
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. Whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl.
3. Add cold butter cubes and work into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs.
4. Gently fold in blueberries.
5. Whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract in a separate bowl.
6. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
7. Pat dough into a 7-inch circle (1-inch thick) on a floured surface.
8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on baking sheet.
9. Brush tops with extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar (optional).
10. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
11. Cool on baking sheet for 5 minutes before transferring to a wire rack.

#### Baker's Tips
- Keep ingredients cold for flaky scones
- Frozen blueberries work well (don't thaw before adding)

Perfect Blueberry Scones

Prep time: 15 minutes | Cook time: 18 minutes | Difficulty: Easy

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Add cold butter cubes and use a pastry cutter or your fingers to work the butter into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs with some pea-sized pieces remaining.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir with a fork until just combined. Do not overmix.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat into a 7-inch circle about 1-inch thick.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes, or until golden brown on top and bottom.
  11. Cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.

### Perfect Blueberry Scones
**Prep time:** 15 minutes  
**Cook time:** 18 minutes  
**Difficulty:** Easy  

**Ingredients:**
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tablespoon baking powder
- 1/2 teaspoon salt
- 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
- 1 cup fresh blueberries
- 2/3 cup heavy cream
- 1 large egg
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
- Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

**Instructions:**
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. Whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
3. Work cold butter into flour mixture until coarse crumbs form.
4. Gently fold in blueberries.
5. Whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
6. Combine wet and dry ingredients until just mixed.
7. Pat dough into a 7-inch circle (1-inch thick) on a floured surface.
8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on baking sheet.
9. Brush tops with extra cream and sprinkle coarse sugar (optional).
10. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
11. Cool on baking sheet for 5 minutes before transferring to a wire rack.

**Baker's Tips:**
- Keep all ingredients cold for flaky scones
- Frozen blueberries can be used (do not thaw)

  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.

  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes, or until golden brown on top and bottom.

data.page_title: Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.page_content:
Blueberry Scones Recipe

Preparation Time: 15 minutes
Cook Time: 20 minutes
Total Time: 35 minutes
Servings: 8 scones

Ingredients:
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tablespoon baking powder
- 1/2 teaspoon salt
- 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
- 1 cup fresh blueberries
- 1 large egg
- 1/2 cup heavy cream, plus extra for brushing
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
- Coarse sugar for sprinkling

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
4. Gently fold in blueberries.
5. In a separate bowl, whisk together egg, heavy cream, and vanilla extract.
6. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
7. Turn dough onto a lightly floured surface and shape into a 7-inch circle.
8. Cut into 8 wedges and transfer to prepared baking sheet.
9. Brush tops with heavy cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
10. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
11. Cool on wire rack for 10 minutes before serving.

Tips:
- Keep butter and cream cold for flaky scones
- Don't overmix the dough
- Fresh or frozen blueberries work well
- Serve with clotted cream or lemon curd

Nutritional Information (per scone):
Calories: 280 | Fat: 14g | Carbs: 34g | Protein: 4g

## Objective 1: Platform Modernization
- **KR1**: Migrate 80% of legacy services to microservices architecture by end of Q1
- **KR2**: Achieve 99.5% API uptime across all migrated services

- **KR1**: Increase daily active users by 15% quarter-over-quarter
- **KR2**: Improve user retention (Day 30) to 65% from current 58%
- **KR3**: Launch 3 major engagement features by March 15
- **Status**: Ahead of schedule - retention at 61% currently

## Objective 3: Revenue Diversification
- **KR1**: Launch subscription tier for power users with $50K ARR target
- **KR2**: Increase enterprise customer count by 20% (from 150 to 180)
- **KR3**: Expand to 2 new geographic markets (APAC & LATAM)
- **Status**: Slightly behind - subscription launch delayed by 2 weeks

## Objective 4: Team Development
- **KR1**: Conduct quarterly performance reviews for all team members by Feb 15
- **KR2**: Achieve 85% employee satisfaction score (up from 78%)
- **KR3**: Complete 3 cross-training sessions between engineering teams
- **Status**: On track

data.page_content:
Blueberry Scones Recipe

Preparation Time: 15 minutes
Cook Time: 20 minutes
Total Time: 35 minutes
Servings: 8 scones

Ingredients:
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tablespoon baking powder
- 1/2 teaspoon salt
- 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
- 1 cup fresh blueberries
- 1 large egg
- 1/2 cup heavy cream, plus extra for brushing
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
- Coarse sugar for sprinkling

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
4. Gently fold in blueberries.
5. In a separate bowl, whisk together egg, heavy cream, and vanilla extract.
6. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
7. Turn dough onto a lightly floured surface and shape into a 7-inch circle.
8. Cut into 8 wedges and transfer to prepared baking sheet.
9. Brush tops with heavy cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
10. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
11. Cool on wire rack for 10 minutes before serving.

Tips:
- Keep butter and cream cold for flaky scones
- Don't overmix the dough
- Fresh or frozen blueberries work well
- Serve with clotted cream or lemon curd

Perfect Blueberry Scones

Prep time: 15 minutes | Cook time: 18 minutes | Difficulty: Easy

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Add cold butter cubes and use a pastry cutter or your fingers to work the butter into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs with some pea-sized pieces remaining.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir with a fork until just combined. Do not overmix.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat into a 7-inch circle about 1-inch thick.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes, or until golden brown on top and bottom.
  11. Cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.

- 1/2 teaspoon salt
- 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
- 1 cup fresh blueberries
- 1 large egg
- 1/2 cup heavy cream, plus extra for brushing
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
- Coarse sugar for sprinkling

**Instructions:**
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. Whisk together dry ingredients.
3. Cut in cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
4. Gently fold in blueberries.
5. Whisk together wet ingredients in separate bowl.
6. Combine wet and dry ingredients until just mixed.
7. Shape dough into 7-inch circle on floured surface.
8. Cut into 8 wedges and transfer to baking sheet.
9. Brush tops with cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
10. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
11. Cool on wire rack for 10 minutes before serving.

**Tips:**
- Keep ingredients cold for flakier scones
- Don't overmix the dough
- Works with fresh or frozen blueberries

data.page_content:
Blueberry Scones Recipe

Preparation Time: 15 minutes
Cook Time: 20 minutes
Total Time: 35 minutes
Servings: 8 scones

Ingredients:
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tablespoon baking powder
- 1/2 teaspoon salt
- 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
- 1 cup fresh blueberries
- 1 large egg
- 1/2 cup heavy cream, plus extra for brushing
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
- Coarse sugar for sprinkling

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
4. Gently fold in blueberries.
5. In a separate bowl, whisk together egg, heavy cream, and vanilla extract.
6. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
7. Turn dough onto a lightly floured surface and shape into a 7-inch circle.
8. Cut into 8 wedges and transfer to prepared baking sheet.
9. Brush tops with heavy cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
10. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
11. Cool on wire rack for 10 minutes before serving.

Tips:
- Keep butter and cream cold for flaky scones
- Don't overmix the dough
- Fresh or frozen blueberries work well
- Serve with clotted cream or lemon curd

Calories: 280 | Fat: 14g | Carbs: 34g | Protein: 4g

note.title: 2026 Q1 OKRs - Main Objectives
note.content:
# 2026 Q1 OKRs - Key Objectives and Key Results

## Objective 1: Platform Modernization
- **KR1**: Migrate 80% of legacy services to microservices architecture by end of Q1
- **KR2**: Achieve 99.5% API uptime across all migrated services
- **KR3**: Reduce average API response time by 30% compared to Q4 2025
- **Status**: On track - 45% migration completed

## Objective 2: User Growth & Engagement
- **KR1**: Increase daily active users by 15% quarter-over-quarter
- **KR2**: Improve user retention (Day 30) to 65% from current 58%
- **KR3**: Launch 3 major engagement features by March 15
- **Status**: Ahead of schedule - retention at 61% currently

## Objective 3: Revenue Diversification
- **KR1**: Launch subscription tier for power users with $50K ARR target
- **KR2**: Increase enterprise customer count by 20% (from 150 to 180)
- **KR3**: Expand to 2 new geographic markets (APAC & LATAM)
- **Status**: Slightly behind - subscription launch delayed by 2 weeks

## Objective 4: Team Development
- **KR1**: Conduct quarterly performance reviews for all team members by Feb 15
- **KR2**: Achieve 85% employee satisfaction score (up from 78%)
- **KR3**: Complete 3 cross-training sessions between engineering teams
- **Status**: On track

## Key Dependencies & Risks:
1. Engineering team capacity constraints may affect Objective 3 timelines
2. Market research for new geographic expansion delayed by vendor issues
3. Budget approval for new hiring still pending from finance

## Next Review: 2026-02-15
## Last Updated: 2026-01-28

  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Add cold butter cubes and use a pastry cutter or your fingers to work the butter into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs with some pea-sized pieces remaining.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir with a fork until just combined. Do not overmix.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat into a 7-inch circle about 1-inch thick.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes, or until golden brown on top and bottom.
  11. Cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.

data.page_content:
Perfect Blueberry Scones

Prep time: 15 minutes | Cook time: 18 minutes | Difficulty: Easy

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Add cold butter cubes and use a pastry cutter or your fingers to work the butter into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs with some pea-sized pieces remaining.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir with a fork until just combined. Do not overmix.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat into a 7-inch circle about 1-inch thick.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes, or until golden brown on top and bottom.
  11. Cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.

  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

Instructions

  3. Add cold butter cubes and use a pastry cutter or your fingers to work the butter into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs with some pea-sized pieces remaining.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir with a fork until just combined. Do not overmix.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat into a 7-inch circle about 1-inch thick.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes, or until golden brown on top and bottom.

data.page_content:
Perfect Blueberry Scones

Prep time: 15 minutes | Cook time: 18 minutes | Difficulty: Easy

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Add cold butter cubes and use a pastry cutter or your fingers to work the butter into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs with some pea-sized pieces remaining.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir with a fork until just combined. Do not overmix.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat into a 7-inch circle about 1-inch thick.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes, or until golden brown on top and bottom.
  11. Cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.

  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Add cold butter cubes and use a pastry cutter or your fingers to work the butter into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs with some pea-sized pieces remaining.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir with a fork until just combined. Do not overmix.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat into a 7-inch circle about 1-inch thick.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes, or until golden brown on top and bottom.
  11. Cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.

**Perfect Blueberry Scones Recipe**
- **Prep time**: 15 minutes

**Ingredients**:
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tablespoon baking powder
- 1/2 teaspoon salt
- 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
- 1 cup fresh blueberries
- 2/3 cup heavy cream
- 1 large egg
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
- Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

**Instructions**:
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.

6. Pat dough into a 7-inch circle, cut into 8 wedges.
7. Brush with cream, sprinkle sugar, and bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
8. Cool before serving.

**Baker's Tips**:

data.page_title: Perfect Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.page_content:
Perfect Blueberry Scones

Prep time: 15 minutes | Cook time: 18 minutes | Difficulty: Easy

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Add cold butter cubes and use a pastry cutter or your fingers to work the butter into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs with some pea-sized pieces remaining.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir with a fork until just combined. Do not overmix.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat into a 7-inch circle about 1-inch thick.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes, or until golden brown on top and bottom.
  11. Cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.

note.title: 2026 Q1 OKRs - Main Objectives
note.content:
# 2026 Q1 OKRs - Key Objectives and Key Results

## Objective 1: Platform Modernization
- **KR1**: Migrate 80% of legacy services to microservices architecture by end of Q1
- **KR2**: Achieve 99.5% API uptime across all migrated services
- **KR3**: Reduce average API response time by 30% compared to Q4 2025
- **Status**: On track - 45% migration completed

## Objective 2: User Growth & Engagement
- **KR1**: Increase daily active users by 15% quarter-over-quarter
- **KR2**: Improve user retention (Day 30) to 65% from current 58%
- **KR3**: Launch 3 major engagement features by March 15
- **Status**: Ahead of schedule - retention at 61% currently

## Objective 3: Revenue Diversification
- **KR1**: Launch subscription tier for power users with $50K ARR target
- **KR2**: Increase enterprise customer count by 20% (from 150 to 180)
- **KR3**: Expand to 2 new geographic markets (APAC & LATAM)
- **Status**: Slightly behind - subscription launch delayed by 2 weeks

## Objective 4: Team Development
- **KR1**: Conduct quarterly performance reviews for all team members by Feb 15
- **KR2**: Achieve 85% employee satisfaction score (up from 78%)
- **KR3**: Complete 3 cross-training sessions between engineering teams
- **Status**: On track

## Key Dependencies & Risks:
1. Engineering team capacity constraints may affect Objective 3 timelines
2. Market research for new geographic expansion delayed by vendor issues
3. Budget approval for new hiring still pending from finance

## Next Review: 2026-02-15
## Last Updated: 2026-01-28

### Perfect Blueberry Scones Recipe
**Prep time:** 15 minutes  
**Cook time:** 18 minutes  
**Difficulty:** Easy  

#### Ingredients:
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tablespoon baking powder
- 1/2 teaspoon salt
- 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
- 1 cup fresh blueberries
- 2/3 cup heavy cream
- 1 large egg
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
- Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

#### Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. Whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
3. Add cold butter cubes and work into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs.
4. Gently fold in blueberries.
5. Whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
6. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
7. Pat dough into a 7-inch circle (1-inch thick) on a floured surface.
8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the baking sheet.
9. Brush tops with extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar (optional).
10. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
11. Cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack.

#### Baker's Tips:
- Keep ingredients cold for flaky scones.
- Use frozen blueberries if fresh ones aren't available.

  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.

data.page_title: Perfect Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.page_content:
Perfect Blueberry Scones

Prep time: 15 minutes | Cook time: 18 minutes | Difficulty: Easy

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Add cold butter cubes and use a pastry cutter or your fingers to work the butter into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs with some pea-sized pieces remaining.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir with a fork until just combined. Do not overmix.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat into a 7-inch circle about 1-inch thick.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes, or until golden brown on top and bottom.
  11. Cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.

data.page_content:
Perfect Blueberry Scones

Prep time: 15 minutes | Cook time: 18 minutes | Difficulty: Easy

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Add cold butter cubes and use a pastry cutter or your fingers to work the butter into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs with some pea-sized pieces remaining.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir with a fork until just combined. Do not overmix.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat into a 7-inch circle about 1-inch thick.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes, or until golden brown on top and bottom.
  11. Cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.

# 2026 Q1 OKRs - Key Objectives and Key Results

## Objective 1: Platform Modernization
- **KR1**: Migrate 80% of legacy services to microservices architecture by end of Q1
- **KR2**: Achieve 99.5% API uptime across all migrated services
- **KR3**: Reduce average API response time by 30% compared to Q4 2025
- **Status**: On track - 45% migration completed

## Objective 2: User Growth & Engagement
- **KR1**: Increase daily active users by 15% quarter-over-quarter
- **KR2**: Improve user retention (Day 30) to 65% from current 58%
- **KR3**: Launch 3 major engagement features by March 15
- **Status**: Ahead of schedule - retention at 61% currently

## Objective 3: Revenue Diversification
- **KR1**: Launch subscription tier for power users with $50K ARR target
- **KR2**: Increase enterprise customer count by 20% (from 150 to 180)
- **KR3**: Expand to 2 new geographic markets (APAC & LATAM)
- **Status**: Slightly behind - subscription launch delayed by 2 weeks

## Objective 4: Team Development
- **KR1**: Conduct quarterly performance reviews for all team members by Feb 15
- **KR2**: Achieve 85% employee satisfaction score (up from 78%)
- **KR3**: Complete 3 cross-training sessions between engineering teams
- **Status**: On track

## Key Dependencies & Risks:
1. Engineering team capacity constraints may affect Objective 3 timelines
2. Market research for new geographic expansion delayed by vendor issues
3. Budget approval for new hiring still pending from finance

data.page_title: Perfect Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.page_content:
Perfect Blueberry Scones

Prep time: 15 minutes | Cook time: 18 minutes | Difficulty: Easy

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Add cold butter cubes and use a pastry cutter or your fingers to work the butter into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs with some pea-sized pieces remaining.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir with a fork until just combined. Do not overmix.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat into a 7-inch circle about 1-inch thick.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes, or until golden brown on top and bottom.
  11. Cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.

Perfect Blueberry Scones

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Add cold butter cubes and use a pastry cutter or your fingers to work the butter into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs with some pea-sized pieces remaining.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir with a fork until just combined. Do not overmix.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat into a 7-inch circle about 1-inch thick.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes, or until golden brown on top and bottom.
  11. Cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.

data.page_content:
Perfect Blueberry Scones

Prep time: 15 minutes | Cook time: 18 minutes | Difficulty: Easy

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Add cold butter cubes and use a pastry cutter or your fingers to work the butter into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs with some pea-sized pieces remaining.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir with a fork until just combined. Do not overmix.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat into a 7-inch circle about 1-inch thick.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes, or until golden brown on top and bottom.
  11. Cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.

Ingredients

  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh or frozen blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.

  8. Place wedges on the prepared baking sheet and bake for 18-22 minutes, until golden brown.

data.html_content:
Blueberry Scones

Prep Time: 15 minutes

Cook Time: 20 minutes

Servings: 8 scones

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh or frozen blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry blender or your fingers until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in the blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn the dough onto a lightly floured surface and shape into an 8-inch circle. Cut into 8 wedges.
  8. Place wedges on the prepared baking sheet and bake for 18-22 minutes, until golden brown.
  9. Let cool slightly before serving.

Notes

For best results, use cold ingredients and avoid overmixing the dough.

data.page_content:
Perfect Blueberry Scones

Prep time: 15 minutes | Cook time: 18 minutes | Difficulty: Easy

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Add cold butter cubes and use a pastry cutter or your fingers to work the butter into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs with some pea-sized pieces remaining.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir with a fork until just combined. Do not overmix.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat into a 7-inch circle about 1-inch thick.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes, or until golden brown on top and bottom.
  11. Cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.

# 2026 Q1 OKRs - Key Objectives and Key Results

## Objective 1: Platform Modernization
- **KR1**: Migrate 80% of legacy services to microservices architecture by end of Q1
- **KR2**: Achieve 99.5% API uptime across all migrated services
- **KR3**: Reduce average API response time by 30% compared to Q4 2025
- **Status**: On track - 45% migration completed

## Objective 2: User Growth & Engagement
- **KR1**: Increase daily active users by 15% quarter-over-quarter
- **KR2**: Improve user retention (Day 30) to 65% from current 58%
- **KR3**: Launch 3 major engagement features by March 15
- **Status**: Ahead of schedule - retention at 61% currently

## Objective 3: Revenue Diversification
- **KR1**: Launch subscription tier for power users with $50K ARR target
- **KR2**: Increase enterprise customer count by 20% (from 150 to 180)
- **KR3**: Expand to 2 new geographic markets (APAC & LATAM)
- **Status**: Slightly behind - subscription launch delayed by 2 weeks

## Objective 4: Team Development
- **KR1**: Conduct quarterly performance reviews for all team members by Feb 15
- **KR2**: Achieve 85% employee satisfaction score (up from 78%)
- **KR3**: Complete 3 cross-training sessions between engineering teams
- **Status**: On track

## Key Dependencies & Risks:
1. Engineering team capacity constraints may affect Objective 3 timelines
2. Market research for new geographic expansion delayed by vendor issues
3. Budget approval for new hiring still pending from finance

data.page_title: Perfect Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.page_content:
Perfect Blueberry Scones

Prep time: 15 minutes | Cook time: 18 minutes | Difficulty: Easy

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Add cold butter cubes and use a pastry cutter or your fingers to work the butter into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs with some pea-sized pieces remaining.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir with a fork until just combined. Do not overmix.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat into a 7-inch circle about 1-inch thick.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes, or until golden brown on top and bottom.
  11. Cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.

**Perfect Blueberry Scones**  
Prep time: 15 minutes | Cook time: 18 minutes | Difficulty: Easy

**Ingredients:**
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tablespoon baking powder
- 1/2 teaspoon salt
- 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
- 1 cup fresh blueberries
- 2/3 cup heavy cream
- 1 large egg
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
- Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

**Instructions:**
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. Whisk together dry ingredients.
3. Cut in cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
4. Gently fold in blueberries.
5. Whisk together wet ingredients in a separate bowl.

Perfect Blueberry Scones

Prep time: 15 minutes | Cook time: 18 minutes | Difficulty: Easy

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Add cold butter cubes and use a pastry cutter or your fingers to work the butter into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs with some pea-sized pieces remaining.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir with a fork until just combined. Do not overmix.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat into a 7-inch circle about 1-inch thick.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes, or until golden brown on top and bottom.
  11. Cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.

# 2026 Q1 OKRs - Key Objectives and Key Results

## Objective 1: Platform Modernization
- **KR1**: Migrate 80% of legacy services to microservices architecture by end of Q1
- **KR2**: Achieve 99.5% API uptime across all migrated services
- **KR3**: Reduce average API response time by 30% compared to Q4 2025
- **Status**: On track - 45% migration completed

## Objective 2: User Growth & Engagement
- **KR1**: Increase daily active users by 15% quarter-over-quarter
- **KR2**: Improve user retention (Day 30) to 65% from current 58%
- **KR3**: Launch 3 major engagement features by March 15
- **Status**: Ahead of schedule - retention at 61% currently

## Objective 3: Revenue Diversification
- **KR1**: Launch subscription tier for power users with $50K ARR target
- **KR2**: Increase enterprise customer count by 20% (from 150 to 180)
- **KR3**: Expand to 2 new geographic markets (APAC & LATAM)
- **Status**: Slightly behind - subscription launch delayed by 2 weeks

## Objective 4: Team Development
- **KR1**: Conduct quarterly performance reviews for all team members by Feb 15
- **KR2**: Achieve 85% employee satisfaction score (up from 78%)
- **KR3**: Complete 3 cross-training sessions between engineering teams
- **Status**: On track

## Key Dependencies & Risks:
1. Engineering team capacity constraints may affect Objective 3 timelines
2. Market research for new geographic expansion delayed by vendor issues
3. Budget approval for new hiring still pending from finance

data.page_content:
Perfect Blueberry Scones

Prep time: 15 minutes | Cook time: 18 minutes | Difficulty: Easy

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Add cold butter cubes and use a pastry cutter or your fingers to work the butter into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs with some pea-sized pieces remaining.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir with a fork until just combined. Do not overmix.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat into a 7-inch circle about 1-inch thick.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes, or until golden brown on top and bottom.
  11. Cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.

  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

  3. Add cold butter cubes and use a pastry cutter or your fingers to work the butter into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs with some pea-sized pieces remaining.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir with a fork until just combined. Do not overmix.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat into a 7-inch circle about 1-inch thick.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes, or until golden brown on top and bottom.
